entities.summary: Dominique Hasler is a Liechtensteiner politician who served as a government councillor for Foreign Affairs, Education and Sport from 2021 to 2025. She was also the President of the Committee of Ministers of the Council of Europe from 2023 to 2024. She previously served as a government councillor for the Interior, Education and Environment from 2017 to 2021.
